button.label: Rejoin MPC Chunks
button.screentip: Rejoin MPC chunks in this folder
button.supertip: Finds messages with X-MPC-* headers in the current folder and joins each complete set of chunks into one message. Sets with chunks still missing are left alone.

toggleButton.label: Split on Send
toggleButton.supertip: When the first To recipient's domain publishes _mpc1._tcp / _mpc2._tcp SRV records, split the message into chunks sent through those servers.

toggleButton.label: Rejoin New Mail
toggleButton.supertip: Check the Inbox for complete sets of MPC chunks at startup and whenever new mail arrives.

button.label: MPC Settings
button.supertip: Opens settings.ini, where you can set DNS servers for the SRV lookups, how many days of mail to scan, and whether rejoined chunks are deleted. Restart Outlook after editing it.
